value.rationale: The Desargues graph is a natural highly symmetric middle-level hypercube and bipartite Kneser testbed. The complete balanced-cut size distribution and especially a sharp minimum width six versus connected-exchange width ten capture how locally stable near-optimal partitions are disconnected. They are mathematically motivated network-cut invariants and a full finite energy-landscape classification, not a routine restatement of the minimum number.
